data.title: Paul Tudor Jones’ Fund Raises IBIT Holdings 98% to $64.6 Million
data.description:
Paul Tudor Jones’ macro fund, Tudor Investment Corporation, increased its holdings in BlackRock’s iShares Bitcoin Trust (IBIT) by 98% in the third quarter of 2026, to about $64.6 million.

According to Odaily, a 13F filing submitted to the SEC on November 16 showed the fund held 1,363,567 IBIT shares as of September 30, up 675,038 shares from 688,529 at the end of the second quarter. The earlier position was valued at $22.9 million.

data.title: Dollar Set for Longest Monthly Winning Streak in Two Years
data.description:
According to ChainCatcher citing Bloomberg, the U.S. dollar is on track for its longest run of monthly gains in two years, Bloomberg reported on November 26. The Bloomberg Dollar Spot Index rose 1.8% in November and is poised to advance for a third consecutive month.

The dollar has strengthened against all Group of 10 currencies, including the Japanese yen and Swiss franc. The rally, driven by the unwinding of AI-related trades and rising interest rates that boosted demand for safe-haven assets, would mark the longest monthly winning streak since 2024.

data.title: Bitcoin Core Contributor Reveals Wallet-to-IP Link Can Cost Under $0.35
data.description:
According to ChainCatcher citing CoinDesk, Bitcoin Core contributor Abubakar Sadiq Ismail said in a November 25 post on the Delving Bitcoin developer forum that Bitcoin Core wallets automatically rebroadcast transactions after they remain unconfirmed for about 12 to 36 hours. The behavior could be used to link monitored Bitcoin addresses to the IP addresses of the nodes associated with them.

Ismail conducted 30 tests on a test network running standard Bitcoin Core and identified the correct node in all 30. The method has not yet been measured on Bitcoin’s mainnet. Based on a Bitcoin price of about $60,000, each attempt costs an estimated $0.18 to $0.34, or less than $0.35.

The issue affects Bitcoin Core hot wallets and watch-only wallets, as well as Sparrow in Core mode, Specter, Liana, JoinMarket and Electrum Personal Server. Nodes using Tor while retaining a clearnet connection may still expose their real IP addresses when rebroadcasting. Using only the onion network or disabling wallet broadcasts can limit exposure. Funds and private keys are not affected, according to the report.

A code-change proposal, PR #36482, has not been released. Bitcoin Core contributor Martin Zumsande said the proposal would only modestly increase the cost of the method and recommended making rebroadcasts after receipt of a payment an opt-in feature.

data.title: Mike Howell: Bitcoin to Be Top Allocation Asset as Financial Liquidity Returns
data.description:
CrossBorder Capital founder Mike Howell recommends that investors gradually allocate to gold, silver and Bitcoin with a two-year investment horizon rather than focus on short-term returns. According to Odaily, Howell says that when the global real economy cools, U.S. Treasury yields fall and liquidity flows back into the financial system, markets will reach a turning point, with Bitcoin as the preferred allocation asset, followed by gold and silver.

Howell says the global liquidity cycle, which measures the availability of credit and capital, peaked at the end of 2025. He says financial markets are unlikely to move against the cycle and have probably entered a bear market, with difficult conditions for stocks potentially lasting through the end of the first half of 2027. Early signs of the liquidity peak appeared early this year, when Bitcoin, the asset most sensitive to global liquidity, peaked near $125,000. Gold and silver weakened afterward, and bond and stock markets also came under pressure from tighter liquidity. Howell says heavy capital spending in AI, expansion of the real economy, corporate bond issuance by large technology companies and fundraising for mega IPOs are creating substantial demand for capital markets.

data.title: South Korea Considers Expanding Stock Market Stabilization Fund
data.description:
South Korea is reviewing an expansion of its stock market stabilization fund and procedures for activating it during periods of increased market volatility. According to Odaily, Finance Minister Lee Hyeong-il will meet Friday with Bank of Korea Governor Shin Hyun-song, Financial Services Commission Chairman Lee Eog-weon and Financial Supervisory Service Governor Lee Chan-jin to discuss procedures related to the fund.

A Finance Ministry official said verifying the activation procedures is the current priority and that no decision has been made on whether to use the fund under current conditions. Financial authorities are considering increasing its size beyond the 10.76 trillion won already committed. Lee previously said the fund’s size would be reviewed based on circumstances when it is activated.

data.title: Flop Labs Opens FLOP Testnet Miner Access, With More Than 50 Miners Online
data.description: Flop Labs has opened miner access to the FLOP testnet. According to Odaily, more than 50 miners are online, using GPUs including the RTX 3090, H200 and B300; the devices have completed on-chain calibration and are available to provide services. The project has invited more GPU owners to join the testnet.

data.title: Trump Says Jensen Huang Is “Fine,” Citing Information He Has
data.description: U.S. President Donald Trump said Jensen Huang was “fine,” citing information in his possession, after a reporter asked how he could determine Huang posed no security threat when the Justice Department had not conducted an appropriate investigation. According to Odaily, the reporter asked what information Trump was relying on, and Trump replied that he had a lot of information.

data.title: Data Shows More Than 5.3 Million Bitcoin Have Not Moved in 7 Years, While 8.5 Million BTC Have Been Held for Over 3 Years
data.description: More than 5.3 million Bitcoin have not moved for seven years, while more than 8.5 million BTC have been held for over three years. According to Odaily, the figures are based on holding periods, or HODL cycles, and reflect that a large amount of Bitcoin remains in long-term holding.

data.title: ZEC’s Fourth-Largest Long Trader Loracle Stops Out of 29% of Position, Still Holds $4.52 Million Long
data.description: ZEC trader Loracle, the market’s fourth-largest long, stopped out of 29% of its position but still holds a $4.52 million ZEC long. According to Odaily, Hyperbot data showed the stopped-out position incurred a loss of about $210,000, while the remaining position had been held for about two days. The trade opened on November 25 at $726.27, with an initial position of about $480,000. Loracle added to the position once, bringing cumulative additions to about $6.68 million, using 10x leverage.

data.title: Glassnode: Bitcoin Continues to Find Buying Support After Retesting June Low
data.description: Bitcoin is still holding above this year's summer low, Glassnode said. According to Odaily, the August breakout has been fully retraced, bringing the price back near the June low. Although Bitcoin briefly dipped below that level twice, every daily candle closed above it, indicating buyers continued to defend the key support.

data.title: Trump Says Jensen Huang's 'Second Term' Will Be Better Than His First
data.description: According to Odaily, U.S. President Donald Trump said he had done something great for the country and the world, adding that Jensen Huang's “second term” would be better than his “first term.”

data.title: Arthur Hayes Warns of Weekend Crypto Sell-Off if Fed Does Not Turn Dovish
data.description: Arthur Hayes said cryptocurrencies and other liquid assets could face a sell-off before U.S. stock markets open Monday if the Federal Reserve does not make dovish remarks before close of business Friday (U.S. Eastern Time), ahead of the FOMC quiet period. According to PANews, Hayes said the weekend market could become “exciting” and urged investors to stay safe.

data.title: Chainlink Reserve Receives 122,450 LINK, Bringing Holdings to 6.93 Million Worth $64.22 Million
data.description: Chainlink Reserve received 122,450 LINK on November 26, worth about $1.13 million, according to Onchain Lens. According to Odaily, the reserve now holds 6.93 million LINK valued at $64.22 million and is backed by @rainbetcom.

data.title: Trump Says He May Speak With Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang Soon
data.description: U.S. President Donald Trump said he may speak with Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang soon. According to Odaily, Trump had previously expressed concern about an earlier market decline.

data.title: Sui-Based Bluefin to Shut Down Perpetuals on December 4, 2026
data.description:
According to ChainCatcher, Sui-based decentralized exchange Bluefin will stop offering Bluefin Perps perpetual contracts at 21:00 UTC on December 4, 2026. Users must close open positions before trading ends, though withdrawals will remain available for a period afterward.

Bluefin said it has recorded more than $100 billion in cumulative trading volume and has over 2.5 million accounts. Bluefin Perps accounts for 95% of the Sui network’s historical perpetual contract trading volume.

Bluefin said it will focus resources on developing Bluefin Spot and expanding into asset tokenization and real-world assets. The underlying infrastructure for Bluefin Perps will continue to be made available to the community and potential partners through the Bluefin Liquidity Network program.

data.title: Unique Network to Shut Down on January 26, 2027
data.description:
According to ChainCatcher, the Polkadot and Kusama ecosystem NFT chain Unique Network will shut down on January 26, 2027, after seven years of operation. The team said it had developed NFT technology but had not attracted users, and that it no longer had enough funding to keep the chain running.

The team recommended that projects built on Unique Network move their collections and NFT issuance to Polkadot AssetHub, with instructions available in Polkadot documentation. Unique Network’s code is open source and available on GitHub for those who need it.

data.title: Fluid Pauses DEX Swaps for Mythos 5.2 Security Review
data.description:
According to ChainCatcher, DeFi lending protocol Fluid has paused DEX swaps while it conducts a security review code-named Mythos 5.2.

The protocol said borrowers can continue repaying loans and users can still withdraw funds during the pause. It did not provide a date for when DEX trading will resume.

data.title: Researcher Demonstrates Bitcoin Core Wallet Privacy Vulnerability
data.description: According to ChainCatcher citing a post on X, a researcher demonstrated a privacy vulnerability in the Bitcoin Core wallet. In a controlled simulation, the flaw linked Bitcoin addresses to their associated nodes with 100% accuracy. The result was presented as the researcher’s demonstration and has not been independently verified.
